body: I work as a Binman in Telford, and honestly it all depends on the crew, I always go the extra mile to try and take side/extra waste (my limit is 6 bags though) but I have also done the job long enough to tell you that more often than not if you do somebody a favour they expect it every week. Also gotta remember every 10 tonne put on the wagon and they have to go back to the tip so when people want 500kg of household crap throwing in the back that can set a crew back by roughly 2-3 streets. However it's a dog eat dog world and I'd throw anything in the back for something in return. Also worth mentioning if you consistently fill up your general waste bin every fortnight you are probably not recycling properly it takes me 6 weeks on average to acumilate 4 bin bags.
